in_sanskrit.name: Litan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Protection
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Litan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Litan is the deity of protection, guardian, and security. He is believed to be the preserver of the universe and the protector of his devotees. Worshipped for strength, courage, and prosperity.
